title: NZXT Recalls H1 Computer Cases Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Metal screws that attach the PCIe riser assembly to the chassis can cause a short in the printed circuit board and overheating, posing a fire hazard due to the circuit board's design. Units: About 32,000 (In addition, about 1,024 were sold in Canada).

title: Rep Fitness Recalls Strap Safety Brackets Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: If the brackets are improperly welded, a sudden drop of weight onto the Strap Safeties can cause the brackets to detach from the weightlifting device, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 1,940.

title: Yamaha Recalls Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Due to Crash and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The vehicles' rear shock absorber mounts can break, posing crash and injury hazards. Units: About 820.

title: Edsal Recalls 2.2 Million Shelving Units Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The shelves can fail to support the 800-pound weight load as stated on the packaging, posing an injury hazard to the consumer. Units: About 2,200,000.

title: Nautilus Recalls Bowflex SelectTech Barbells Due to Impact Injury Hazard
summary: A weight plate can fall from the end of the barbell, posing an impact injury hazard. Units: About 3,700.

title: Enerco Group Recalls DeWALT Cordless Kerosene Heaters Due to Fire and Carbon Monoxide Poisoning Hazards
summary: The heaters can re-start unexpectedly while in standby mode if the room temperature falls below the thermostat set point, posing fire and carbon monoxide poisoning hazards. Units: About 4,500.

title: Victory Innovations Recalls Electrostatic Sprayers with Lithium-ion Battery Packs Due to Fire and Explosion Hazards
summary: The sprayer's rechargeable lithium-ion battery pack can overheat and melt, posing a risk of the product catching fire and/or exploding. Units: About 405,000 (In addition, 27,000 in Canada).

title: Dr. Reddy's Recalls Prescription Drug Blister Packages Due to Risk of Poisoning
summary: The products are prescription medications that were labeled and distributed by Dr. Reddy's for institutional use only. title: Home Depot Recalls Wood Windsor Dining Chair Sets Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The chair's back can detach, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 3,100.

title: MTIG Productions Recalls deSensua Wintergreen, Birch and Pain Soother Essential Oils Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Packaging Requirement; Risk of Poisoning (Recall Alert)
summary: The products contain the substance methyl salicylate which must be in child resistant packaging as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act (PPPA). The packaging of the products is not child resistant, posing a risk of poisoning if the contents are swallowed by young children. Units: About 1,

title: Northern Tool & Equipment Recalls Powerhorse Portable Generators Due to Shock Hazard
summary: The portable generators have a wiring error which can result in an electrical shock to users. Units: About 3,640.

title: Potter Electric Recalls Addressable Pull Stations Single/Dual Action Due to Failure to Alert to Fire
summary: The pull handle on some units can fail to activate the fire alarm system when manually pulled, posing a risk of failure to alert consumers to a fire. Units: About 735.

title: SmartPool Recalls Children's Multi-Purpose Helmets Due to Risk of Head Injury
summary: The recalled helmets were incorrectly advertised and marketed for children aged 2 years or older. However, the recalled helmets do not comply with minimum safety requirements for children younger than 5 and pose a risk of head injury to those children. Units: About 480.

title: Urban Outfitters Recalls Margo Taper Candle Holders Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The candle holders can catch on fire if they come in contact with the candle's flame, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 2,700 (In addition, about 60 in Canada).

title: Anker Play Products Recalls 10-in-1 Incredible Inventions Science Kit Due to Violation of the Federal Lead Paint Ban
summary: Paint on the red and blue magnet contains levels of lead that exceed the federal lead paint ban. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health issues. In addition, the product packaging lacks the required warning labels for magnets and balloons. Units: About 13,000.

title: Jimco Lamps Recalls Accent Tables with Charging Receptacles Due to Shock Hazard
summary: The convenience charging receptacles and/or USB ports installed in the accent tables can have an electrical issue resulting in reverse polarity, which can pose a shock hazard to the user. Units: About 99,000 (In addition, 11,000 units were sold in Canada).

title: National Presto Recalls Smokers Due to Electric Shock Hazard
summary: The heating element/wiring on the smoker is defective, posing an electric shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 25,000.

title: Primark Recalls Nose Piercing and Body Bars Due to High Levels of Nickel; Risk of Skin Irritation
summary: The nose piercings and body bars have elevated levels of nickel, posing a risk of skin irritation. Units: About 800.

title: Toro Recalls Power Max Snowthrowers Due to Amputation Hazard
summary: The auger can fail to disengage when the control lever is released, posing an amputation hazard. Units: About 6,700.
